summary: Phase 1 iteration 3 (driver-centric relationships) verified end-to-end. Backend: 58/58 pytest pass (39 regression + 19 new across TestSeededDriverEnrichment, TestBackfillLinks, TestCreateWithDriverId for 7 modules, TestDriverProfile auth/404/shape/filtering/isolation, TestComplianceDriverFields). Frontend: all flows pass — Driver Hub shows DRV-001/DRV-002/DRV-003 + ACE Car Freighters columns and clickable names; /drivers/{id} renders driver-name (James Carter), driver-linked-total=5, all 7 profile-section-{slug} blocks with counts (licences=1, truck-rego=1, insurance=1, equipment=1, maintenance=0, tilt-trays=1, onboarding=0) and open-module links; /drivers/nonexistent-xyz redirects to /m/drivers; compliance page driver column shows 3 clickable links navigating to /drivers/{id}; Add dialog driver_id searchable dropdown (trigger+search+options) present and functional on all 7 modules (licences, truck-rego, insurance, equipment, maintenance, tilt-trays, onboarding); option label format 'James Carter DRV-001 · ACE Car Freighters · Sydney'; row-driver-link present on module table rows.

design_issues.screen: Add dialog on /m/onboarding (and other modules with date fields)
issues: Date inputs use native browser date picker (mm/dd/yyyy) instead of shadcn calendar component — pre-existing, not introduced this iteration.

action_items: (Carry-over) Login.jsx setState-in-render warning — wrap auth redirect in useEffect.
(Carry-over) Module count badges briefly show '—' on first hub render — consider skeleton/default 0.
(Optional polish) Replace native date inputs with shadcn calendar in module Add/Edit dialogs.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py backfill_driver_ids() is correctly idempotent — only sets driver_id when missing and only updates driver enrichments when fields absent.
GET /api/drivers/{id}/profile returns _id stripped (uses projection) and groups linked records by 7 fixed slugs — clean contract.
compliance/expiring now resolves driver_name from canonical driver_id with fallback to legacy driver_name text — good migration safety.
Frontend DriverSelect dropdown shows driver_number + company + base — meets searchable UX requirement.
Module table row-driver-link-{id} and compliance-driver-link-{id} testids are properly wired and route to /drivers/{driverId}.
Profile page renders all 7 sections even with 0 linked records (good for discoverability) and exposes profile-section-{slug}, -count, -open testids.
Minor: 2 console 404s observed when visiting /drivers/{nonexistent-id} before client-side redirect fires — harmless but a guarded fetch (or surface 404 toast) would be cleaner.

Maintenance module has no name-based backfill source (intentional — maintenance is keyed by vehicle_rego, not driver) — confirmed in code and verified profile section shows 0 for that slug as expected.
test_credentials: admin@acedriverhub.com / Admin@123 (seeded). TEST_* users from prior iterations remain in users collection.
seed_data_creation: No new seed; verified existing seed: 3 drivers (DRV-001/002/003 ACE Car Freighters) with backfilled driver_id on James (5 linked: 1 licence, 1 truck-rego, 1 insurance, 1 equipment, 1 tilt-tray), Liam (4), Noah (2). Test-created records are deleted in teardown.
context_for_next_testing_agent: New test file /app/backend/tests/test_driver_relationships.py covers driver enrichment, backfill, create-with-driver_id (parametrized over 7 modules), /api/drivers/{id}/profile (auth/404/shape/filtering/isolation) and compliance driver fields. Frontend testids to reuse: driver-name, driver-linked-total, profile-section-{slug}, profile-section-{slug}-count, profile-section-{slug}-open, create-field-driver_id-trigger/search/option-{driverId}, row-driver-link-{rowId}, compliance-driver-link-{recordId}. Required-vs-optional driver_id (required on licences+insurance, optional elsewhere) was not exercised via UI form submit — could be added if Phase 2 changes validation.
